tei:div.tei:p: (1)e ma deng song snyigs ma'i dus/ rdzun gter zog pos rgyal khams gang*/ padma'i chos la ya ga 'bod/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bcos ma'i slad/ snying ma'i rdzun gter nor 'dod dang*/ gsar ma'i rtog ge grags 'dod gnyis/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i chom po yin/ sngon byon nyang gur rgod gsum dang*/ gling pa bcu phrag gcig dang gnyis/ dri med rnam gnyis las gzhan pa'i/ gter ston med na dga' ba la/ gter chos med na skyid pa la/ bcos ma med na bde ba la/ rang gi rtog brjod nges pa'o/ bsod nams rin chen bye ba'i gzhi/ mkha' dbyings 'gags pa gnam la 'char/ stag chen khra bos rtse 'jo rol/ dur phag khra mo'i sna tog bcad/ lding gsum dbyar gyi mtsho mo 'khyil/ dgu gsum me dpal rlung la gzed/ nor 'jin srog pa mkha' dbang nor/ dpal gyi rol mo phyogs bcur rdol/ ༈ yang mi lag sor lnga'i rtse mor yi ge lnga dang*/ de re re nas bcu gsum re 'phro bar shar nas/ tram ni stong gsum gang ba de/ sngon dus 'di yi skye tshe gsum/ bsod nams bsags pa'i dpal la spyod/ (2)hri ni 'gro don 'char ba ste/ ste gnyis 'khor lo mtha' nas rgyas/ oṃ ni gzhi gcig lam gnyis po/ don du dbu yi dpal du spyod/ hūm̐ ni thams cad bdud sde'i dpung*/ ming gi lhag par tshar gcad pa'o/ a ni ka dag spros dang bral/ lhun grub ngang du 'tshang rgya'o/ ༈ yang*/ bkra shis stong khams brdal ba e yi mchog 'gyur med rab bstan lhun po wam̐ yig zung*/ srid pa gsum gyi ma chon khyed gcig pu/ sa gsum ya ma ra jas chom la phab/ bdun gyi brgyad kyi brgyad la srog gi go ru 'jin/ sa ma ya rgyaḥ bstan pa ci tsam gnas la/ sgrom chen rin chen gsal ba de/ mthar 'byung bstan pa'i dbu yi 'jin/ dgongs srog gcig brgyud mnyam pa'i sa/ gdung chen brgyad dang ka ba bzhi/ phyi slob nang 'khor skar ma'i tshogs/ phreng thag bcu gsum yar ngo'i tshad/

phyi nang rten 'brel thabs du mas/ ka ba du mchis gdan rab ste/ gdung ma du mchis gdan 'jin ste/ phyam dral mtshungs pa'i slob tshogs mchis/ rlung chen rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor bskor/ mkhar mo rdzong gi bstan pa'i tshad/ ha ha/ yang (3)dpal chen badzra ku ma ra/ khyod dang skye ba bcu gsum 'grogs/ da dung bcu gnyis bcu gsum 'tsho/ sad 'od pa la 'dren par mchis/ ༈ bde ba chen po'i sku/ lto 'gror phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas/ des rkyen cang shes 'phrul gyi lor/ ri bor zla bar byad kyis bcing*/ rdzing gi 'ol kha las grol na/ bstan 'gro'i spyi dpal e ma rmad/ bcu gsum bcu gsum 'phreng las brgal/ tshe phug don gsum thang la brdal/ phrin las shar gyi sgo mo gsum/ 'byed pas bstan srid phrin las rgyas/ brda yig shar/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi kha byang can mang ngo*/ sprel gyi lo la slob chen bcu/ bya la sgro gshog 'joms pa brgyad/ nor skyong nor khrid bcu gsum 'byung*/ phag nag sngags nag dur sa bzlog byi lam 'ja' lus gdan yang btang*/ glang gi rwa rtse phyogs bcur 'phen/ stag mos sa chen lan gsum dkrugs/ yos kyi rang tshod 'jin pa'i dus sogs brda shar ro/ snga ma'i bcos la/ 'dre kha yas kyis bcos pa dang*/ lha kha tshogs kyis bcos pa dang*/ mi kha (4)glud kyis 'jal ba dang*/ gshin kha khram gyis bcad pa dang*/ zhes pa'i 'phror/ dpal be'u khug bzhi pa g.yas g.yon gyi khug gnyis la lcags kyi thag pa gzi byin can brgyus pas bzung ba la stag yos kyis brten pa'i khug rnams na badzra ku ma ra/ dpal be'u gzhung na byad ma ur rnon zhes babs/ gzhan brda mang ngo*/ ༈ si tu'i yang srid rang gis rang nyid snyed 'gyur de/ mngon sum tshad mas gzhal bar nus/ ༈ yang tshe tshad me stag gsum gyi 'khor lo yos bu'i phreng ba gzhi na rdzogs/ ༈ a ni ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*/ ka ni gsal byed dang po'i tshe/

tsa ri'i tshugs la slebs dus/ pra tra zhes pa'i ming can des/ ta thā ga ta'i thugs kyi sras/ sa saṃ bdud kyis ma slebs par/ ma ma gshin rje'i thugs dam bskul/ sha za mkha' 'gro'i 'bum srog bsdus/ de dus tshe yi tshad nyid 'gyur/ de min shar tshad gang yod kyang*/ stag yos kha 'tha' mi sel med/ lung byang gsal ba'i sgrom bu bzhin/ sa lce/ bkra shis byin ldan yar lung bstan no/
lung bstan skor 'di rnams phyag bris las bshus/ zhus dag/
